Exact requirements will be determined 7 during medical/surgical procedures. The Institute does not guarantee usage of any item during the contract period. Items supplied without prior departmental consent will be rejected, and no payme 8.a nt will be made. A declaration confirming this commitment must be uploaded with the tec 8.b hnical bid (Format B). 8.c Failure to submit the declaration will result in rejection without further communicat ion. Buffer Stock and Emergency Supply The successful bidder must maintain adeq 9 uate buffer stock of contracted items at their Kerala office to avoid disruption of pr ocedures. 9.a Upon notification via email or phone, delivery must be made within 24 hours. Losses or expenses incurred due to cancellation will be recovered from the supplie 14.a r. Further, whenever the Institute is requested to furnish a supply order issued by a s 15.a imilar entity for the tendered item, the bidder shall provide the same, without fail, to substantiate the rate quoted. An affidavit confirming this must be submitted with the technical bid 15.b (Format C). 15.c Failure to submit will result in rejection without further communication.
